history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN — thin placeholder. No verified source identifies a specific 'Lakshmi Narayan Temple' in Bishalgarh town. The prominent Tripura namesake is the Lakshmi Narayan Bari inside the Ujjayanta Palace compound in AGARTALA (built more than 100 years ago by Maharaja Birendra Kishore Manikya, per Tripura Tourism), which is NOT this record. The CSV intent ('local Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi in Bishalgarh') suggests a neighbourhood shrine, but no website, listing, or image attests to it; do not conflate it with the Agartala temple. Built date, history, and opening hours are all unverified; coordinates are town-level for Bishalgarh. CSV 'state' column wrongly held the town name — corrected to Tripura.

name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple
town_description: Bishalgarh is a municipal town in Sepahijala district, Tripura, on the NH 8 (Shillong-Agartala-Sabroom road) about 20-25 km south of Agartala, and the headquarters of the Bishalgarh subdivision. It is a local trading and transit hub with a mix of temples, ashrams, and kali baris serving the surrounding villages.

travel.airport: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala (~24 km; approximate)
travel.road: On NH 8, ~20-25 km south of Agartala; local autos and buses from Bishalgarh bus stand

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not verified — local shrines in the area typically open for morning and evening aarti (verify)
